analysis.reason: 3일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 과매도 구간에서 탈출 시도 중이나(35.5), 아직 추세 전환을 확신하기 어렵다. MACD 히스토그램은 개선되고 있으나 여전히 음수 구간이다. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율이 1.89로 급증했으나, 이는 변동성 확대 가능성을 시사할 뿐 방향성을 확정해주지 않는다. 주봉 ADX 19.2로 추세 강도가 약해, 현재의 움직임을 '충격성 변동'으로 간주하고 관망한다.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a 'wait and see' stance for the third consecutive day. RSI is attempting to exit oversold territory (35.5), but a trend reversal is not yet confirmed. MACD histogram is improving but remains negative. The volume ratio of 1.89 (compared to the 5-day average) indicates increased activity, but this signals potential volatility rather than a confirmed direction. With the weekly ADX at 19.2, indicating weak trend strength, the current movement is considered a 'shock-type fluctuation', warranting a cautious approach.
analysis.weeklyConflict: 주봉 ADX 19.2로 추세 미형성, 일봉 기준 관망 우선
analysis.weeklyConflictEn: Weekly ADX at 19.2 indicates no established trend; daily signals take precedence for observation.

· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (하단 $82.74 근처) + 밴드폭 3.43%로 축소, 횡보 가능성 시사
[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 ($82.77) + 근거 (볼린저 하단, 5일/20일 저가)

· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (Higher Low 아님, Lower High 아님) — 횡보 구간 지속
[거래량·결론]

· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) + RSI 과매도 탈출 시도 확인 시 매수 진입 고려
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($82.85) vs SMA5/20/50 ($83.45/$84.18/$84.78) — Below SMA20/50/100/200, indicating weak short-to-medium term trend.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($85.10)/SMA200 ($85.92) — Confirms downward pressure in the medium-to-long term trend.
· 52-week position (1.6%) + Current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (34.0→35.5) + Attempting to exit oversold territory, showing weak rebound momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (histo -0.1706→-0.0792) + Improving, but weak reversal signal is still faint.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $82.74) + Bandwidth narrowed to 3.43%, suggesting potential for sideways movement.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($82.77) + Basis (Lower BB, 5-day/20-day lows).
· Swing resistance ($84.82) + Breakout could lead to short-term rebound.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Not Higher Low, Not Lower High) — Sideways consolidation continues.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.89x vs 5-day average) + Signal of increased volatility, direction unconfirmed.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + Consider buying on confirmation of RSI exiting oversold.
analysis.patternNote: 현재가 볼린저밴드 하단에 근접하며 횡보 구간을 이어가고 있다. RSI는 과매도 탈출 시도를 하고 있으나 추세 전환을 확신하기에는 이르다.
analysis.patternNoteEn: The current price is approaching the lower Bollinger Band, continuing a sideways consolidation phase. RSI is attempting to exit oversold territory, but it's too early to confirm a trend reversal.

analysis.riskNoteEn: With ADX at 21.8, indicating an unformed trend, current volatility is more likely a shock-type retracement than a trend reversal.
